description: pin-in-bore-fuse's pin moved out through the bore's wall by one or two tolerances (1e-7), turned about the contact's middle so its ends move a quarter of one in and out, or grown by two. The walls then cross in two rulings a few 1e-4 apart, or a traced section beside the contact, around a lens of material a tolerance or two thick. Arris fails: a section edge ends at a node nothing else reaches (Fault::Split, Dangling; one out and the turn), a piece holds no interior point at its clearance (Fault::Split, NoInterior; two out), and the grown pin's union fails the checker (a panic in a debug build). The desired result is a clean union: the bore within the tolerance, the bore with the lens beyond (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
